issues.description: extract_arch_from_url silently returns None, producing a malformed URL with the literal string 'None' in the path.
issues.detail: When the arch regex misses, the function returns None and the caller f-strings it into '.../latest/None/Packages/...'. No exception, no log, just a broken lockfile downstream. Either raise on miss or have the caller check and skip with a loud error. noarch is also a legal arch in this domain and is unhandled.

issues.description: nevra[0] grabs the filename's first character rather than the package name's first letter, an unstated and fragile invariant.
issues.detail: Koji's Packages tree is keyed by the lowercased first letter of the package name. The code takes nevra[0] on a full filename, which coincides today but conflates filename-first-char with name-first-letter. Rename to filename, parse the package name properly, and compute first_letter explicitly so the next maintainer isn't relying on accident.

issues.description: Race condition with coreos-koji-tagger is acknowledged in the commit message and shipped with no in-code mitigation or comment.
issues.detail: URLs are crafted before coreos-koji-tagger actually tags, a real correctness hazard noted only in the PR description. At minimum add a module-level docstring stating the precondition that the lockfile is consumed only after tagging completes, or a retry/verify step. Future maintainers debugging a 404 need to find this in seconds, not hours.

issues.description: Hardcoded arch list and koji base URL/path layout should be lifted to module-level constants or a single helper.
issues.detail: The four-arch list and koji canonical path (/latest/{arch}/Packages/{letter}/{nevra}) are duplicated knowledge buried inside function bodies. A module-level ARCHES tuple and a build_koji_url helper localize the contract so a future koji layout change is a one-line edit instead of a grep. Right data placement makes future edits obvious.

issues.description: Prioritize-coreos-pool logic in query_packages_location is now redundant given use_koji_url_only rewrites everything downstream.
issues.detail: Two filters doing the same job is worse than one. Either the prioritization still matters (document why in a comment) or it is vestigial and should be deleted. Don't leave both halves of a half-finished refactor in the tree.

issues.description: No unit tests for the two new functions despite trivial testability.
issues.detail: Commit says rpms.lock.yaml changes cannot be tested locally, but use_koji_url_only and extract_arch_from_url are pure string functions. Fifteen lines of unit tests would have caught both the nevra[0] and silent-None defects. Write the tests.

synthesis.summary: The panel converges on NEEDS-WORK. The approach — synthesize the koji path directly instead of trusting dnf5's broken baseurl — is sound, but two concrete defects must be fixed before merge: extract_arch_from_url silently returns None and lets the literal string 'None' flow into the URL, and nevra[0] conflates filename-first-char with package-name-first-letter (works by accident). The acknowledged race with coreos-koji-tagger should at least be documented in code, hardcoded constants pulled to module scope, and the now-redundant coreos-pool prioritization either justified or deleted. Add unit tests for the two new pure functions.
